description: Former Ethiopian Air Force 711, then an Ethiopian civil Dakota. Ruud Leeuw recorded it as a hulk near Asmara airport in 2003 and moved to the Expo Park in southern Asmara by June 2006. Its USAAF serial was 42-100820 which corresponds to the construction number 19283 that Spottingmode carries, so the two records agree.

Kenyan-registered freighter damaged by a fuel truck in May 1998 and strafed by an Ethiopian MiG in June 1998 at Asmara. Stripped of engines and wings and moved to the Asmara Expo grounds in June 1999 where it serves as a children's playground.

Soviet transport hit by EPLF rocket shrapnel and used as a barracks by Soviet advisers from 1986. Wings, stabiliser and tail section removed. Moved to the Asmara Expo grounds and used as a children's climbing frame.
